Name: Alternate Anthro Alexis - Anthro Characters Continued Alex Genderswap Add-on
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I've kitbashed together Male-to-Female Genderswap sprites and portraits for Alex/Alexis from the Anthro Characters Continued mod, , since the official genderswap for Alex isn't out. Maybe other people would like it too!

I mashed them together through Alex's original sprites from Sion9000/Gaveliere, the portraits created from  BetasEnjoyer11 (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/5082) , and the clothing and bodies is from AdarinSinner's Alex Girl Mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/387).[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]All planned sprites are completed, including the Beach and Winter outfits, meaning this mod is functionally complete.  I plan to finish the winter sprites for Shane/Shauna and Sebastian/Sabrina next. Then I’ll bundle all three mods together.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]As of May 10, 2026, the official genderswaps are out. But this still exists as an alternate design in case someone likes it more.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download and install Anthro Characters Continued
2. Download this mod, unzip it, and place the folder inside into the Same Directory as your original Anthro Characters Continued patch. Accept Overwrites.[/color][/size]

[b]Installation instructions[/b]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]BetasEnjoyer11 provided made the original portraits and gave me the original copies of them and let me use them![/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Permissions[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]-BetasEnjoyer11 gave me explicit permission to use his portraits[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]-AdarinSinner gave me explicit permission to use his portraits and sprites from his Alex_Girl Mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/387)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]-Alexis's winter outfit is directly taken from Anthro Characters Continued. Gaveliere has https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7342[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]-Alexis's beach outfit is modified from RedK1rby's Female Bachelor - Beach mod. He has general upload and reuse permission. https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7342[/color]
